chunks: Say: 'Indeed, the earlier and the later generations'

key_terms.الْآخِرِينَ: The later ones (people of the present/future)
key_terms.الْأَوَّلِينَ: The earlier ones (people of the past)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'the earlier and the later generations'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a rhetorical challenge to the polytheists of Mecca, asserting that just as the ancient nations perished due to their denial, the current disbelievers face a similar inevitable fate. It underscores the continuity of divine justice across generations, reinforcing the concept that God's knowledge encompasses all of humanity, past and present, without exception.
